title: Encrypted copies to Tabgha over the Kaji line
goal: The nightly encrypted copy also reaches Tabgha over the Kaji line, as the owner chose in F-062-T01
acceptance: Tabgha keeps the newest encrypted copies it receives over the Kaji line; it cannot decrypt them; a missing or refused transfer is reported, never retried in a loop
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: A test across sender and receiver over the Kaji line; final applicable CI

2026-11-14: test/offhost-kaji.test.ts — two enrolled bases on loopback: the nightly copy reaches the accepting base encrypted and only the owner key restores it; a base that does not accept refuses (403), logged once, not asked again; an unreachable peer is reported once and not retried every minute; the receiver checks sender, date and copy shape and keeps the newest.
escalation: Owner agreed 2026-11-14 to a new Kaji message type carrying encrypted backup copies (option A over a mounted share); any further change to the Kaji contract goes back to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 when split from F-062-T03: one Kaji message type, a receiver store and a test across both. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-14 in about 1 h (stated).
